name: Claude Code
description: Run Claude Code on your hosted Subconscious model with gateway env, context limits, and telemetry.

install.note: subc warns, and does not block, below minimum_version.

help.behavior: Launches Claude Code with the active Subconscious profile and model picker. Persistent files are leftover-only: subc claude uninstall.
options: Override the profile model for this launch
args: Pass remaining arguments to Claude Code

inputs.name: CLAUDE_GATEWAY_URL
inputs.label: Claude gateway override
inputs.description: Optional Claude-only gateway origin; blank uses GATEWAY_URL.
inputs.comment: Leave CLAUDE_GATEWAY_URL blank to use GATEWAY_URL above.

inputs.name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY
inputs.label: Claude API key
inputs.description: Claude-specific credential override; blank uses API_KEY.

inputs.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL
inputs.label: Subagent model
inputs.description: Model used by Claude Code subagents. UNSET follows the default model.

inputs.name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS
inputs.label: Maximum context tokens
inputs.description: Maximum context advertised to Claude Code.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer credential. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
env.description: Turns off gateway model discovery; the picker comes from --settings.

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER
env.description: Runs the auto-mode classifier locally: gateway upstreams cannot perform Anthropic's server-side check (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing).

env.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY
env.description: Enables OTEL api_request logs, which the gateway uses for purpose attribution (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage#api-request-event).

env.name: ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS
env.description: Disables claude.ai connectors, which need subscription OAuth and cannot run against the gateway.

env.name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
env.description: Log exporter. OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER and OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER are never set: Claude's telemetry init can abort on an exporter type it does not know.

config.name: --settings
config.description: Replaces the built-in model picker with the live catalog and allowlists only those models.
Written only by older persistent setup. subc claude uninstall removes it; launch never writes it.

on.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW
on.note: Auto-compaction stays on; subc only moves the window.

off.name: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT
off.note: Upstream Claude Code variable. subc never sets it, and this repo does not confirm its behaviour.

range.note: The bounds of the profile setting, from the Claude Code docs (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/context-window#set-the-auto-compact-window). A launch value is not clamped.

mcp.note: subc adds no MCP servers. It disables claude.ai connectors with ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false. User MCP config is left alone.

headers.name: x-claude-code-session-id
headers.note: Sent by Claude Code itself, per a comment in install.sh. Not set by subc.
